Student Alleges Harassment, Car Traced by Police

A Hindu College student has alleged that she was followed by men who attempted to force her and a friend into a car. The incident reportedly occurred around 9:30 pm on Wednesday. Police have traced the SUV allegedly involved in the incident and registered a First Information Report (FIR) at the Mukherjee Nagar police station.
